name: oakenfall
description: Oakenfall — living-world villager simulation and site build.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:sim && npm run verify:hold
scripts.editor: npm run build && node tools/editor-test.mjs && node tools/slots-test.mjs && node tools/steward-test.mjs && node tools/health-check.mjs && node tools/systems-audit.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && node tools/sync-native-version.mjs && cap sync
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.verify:sim: npm run freevars && npm run build && node tools/smoke-test.mjs && node tools/gameplay-test.mjs && node tools/scenario-test.mjs && node tools/editor-test.mjs && node tools/gesture-test.mjs
scripts.verify:hold: node tools/save-test.mjs && node tools/slots-test.mjs && node tools/steward-test.mjs && node tools/health-check.mjs && node tools/systems-audit.mjs && node tools/site-audit.mjs
